name: tinyconv
notes: Not a trained network. Four weight tensors with a small convolutional stack's shapes, generated from the seed by a documented LCG.
No biases, no normalisation, no graph. Each tensor is pruned and accounted for on its own; nothing propagates a removed output channel into the next tensor's input axis.
Output-channel counts are 20, 20, 40 and 10 so that every ratio in the default sweep lands on a whole channel.
